name: Ask User Question
description: Ask the user multiple-choice questions and wait for the answer.

function.name: ask_user_question
function.description: Ask the user 1-4 multiple-choice questions during your turn and wait for their answer. Use it when you are blocked on a decision only the user can make: an ambiguous requirement, a choice between approaches, or a preference. Do NOT use it for things you can decide yourself or look up. The questions appear as an interactive card in the web chat; your turn pauses until the user answers, then the answers come back as this tool's result. The user can always pick 'Other' and type a free-form answer, so do not add an 'Other' option yourself. If one option is your recommendation, put it first and set recommended: true on it; the card shows a 'Recommended' badge. Recommending is optional; leave it out when you have no preference. The user may also close the card without answering (status 'dismissed'): do not assume answers then. Only works in the Evonic web chat; on other channels it returns status 'unavailable' and you should ask in plain text instead.

question.description: The complete question, ending with a question mark.

header.description: Very short label shown as a chip (max 12 chars), e.g. 'Database'.

multiSelect.description: Allow selecting more than one option. Default false.

options.description: 2-4 distinct choices. Do not include an 'Other' option; it is added automatically.

label.description: Short display text for the choice (1-5 words).

description.description: What this choice means or its trade-offs.

recommended.description: Optional. true marks this option as your recommendation (at most one per single-choice question). Do not write '(Recommended)' in the label.
